name: phd-after-admission-course-not-an-earlier-program
description: Policy review round 4, P4-transfer-3 (DGS 2026-10-11: option (a)). A Fall 2026 Ph.D. entrant with a finished master's at Purdue (CS 50300, ruled yes) who took USC's CSCI 570 in Summer 2027, after admission. A course taken while enrolled at Notre Dame is no earlier program (Academic Code §4.6 criterion 3 names it separately): CSCI 570 keeps its own after-admission hold, and Purdue's course counts. It used to make the record read “Transfer credit from 2 earlier graduate programs”, holding CS 50300 too.

detailIncludes: 3 of the 24 credits you may transfer
